comparison.objective: Align pipe flanges and insert locating pins; versions use either stacked four-pin or held horizontal two-pin assembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid flange pose alignment followed by multiple close-tolerance pin insertions.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges meet specified center/axis/hole alignment and pins occupy distinct holes; thresholds vary by version but are numeric.
comparison.reason: Multi-part alignment and pin insertion are different tested abilities from tool-driven particle flow and size-selective separation.
